Apacer AS350 Panther 256GB 2.5" SATAIII SSD – High-Speed Performance for Your PC or Laptop

Upgrade your system's performance with the Apacer AS350 Panther 256GB 2.5" SATAIII SSD. Designed to deliver ultra-fast data transfer speeds, reliability, and durability, this SSD is the perfect storage solution for gamers, professionals, and anyone looking to boost their system’s speed. With fast read and write speeds, easy installation, and energy efficiency, the Apacer AS350 Panther SSD offers the best value for your money in Bangladesh.

Key Features of Apacer AS350 Panther 256GB 2.5" SATAIII SSD:

  • Blazing Fast Speeds: Read Speed: Up to 560MB/s
  • Write Speed: Up to 460MB/sAchieve exceptional speed for booting up your system, loading applications, and transferring files with the Apacer AS350 Panther SSD. Say goodbye to slow load times.
  • Durable and Reliable: Shockproof and vibration-resistant, this SSD is built to last even in tough environments, making it a great option for laptops and portable systems.
  • Energy-Efficient: Consumes less power than traditional HDDs, helping extend battery life on laptops and reduce overall power consumption.
  • SATA III 6Gbps Interface: Enjoy the fastest possible performance with the latest SATA III interface, backward compatible with SATA II and SATA I.
  • 256GB Storage Capacity: Store your operating system, applications, and essential files with ease. Ideal for users who need a reliable, medium-capacity SSD for everyday tasks.
  • TRIM and S.M.A.R.T. Support: Supports TRIM technology for optimized performance and S.M.A.R.T. monitoring to track the health of your SSD, ensuring long-lasting and stable performance.
  • Easy Installation: Simple plug-and-play setup for quick installation without the need for extra software or tools.
